“我们只是少了一个点球，这就是巨大的差距，”这位中场球员说。“你知道安菲尔德，你知道我们的实力。我知道他们是一支伟大的球队，但（如果罚进点球）要想卷土重来对他们来说并不容易。”
伊劳拉声称他会告诉利物浦球员在禁区内倒地——但索博斯莱表示这不是他们的风格。“我不认为在这个时刻你可以想：‘哦，让我等别人碰我然后我再倒下，’”他说。
“不，亚历克斯专注于球，他想把球顶进网里……这是一个点球。我不知道他们对我们的期望是什么，是假摔还是别的什么？我不认为我们是那种会这样做的球队或球员，但从现在开始我们可能需要这么做。如果亚历克斯倒下，这就是一个明显的点球。廷贝尔根本不在乎球在哪里，也许如果他不拉亚历克斯的球衣，亚历克斯就能把球顶进球门。”

bodyEn: Good defending is the mark of champions. At Anfield, where Arsenal had not won in the past 13 visits, Mikel Arteta followed the orthodoxy of locking down once his team took the lead. This time around, it proved successful. Arsenal did not allow the occasion or the stadium to get to them as they have on previous occasions. In April 2023, Granit Xhaka entangling with Trent Alexander-Arnold energised home fans previously despondent that Arsenal were 2-0 up. It finished 2-2. On Sunday, Liverpool zipped around zestfully, as Andoni Iraola requests, though the final-ball quality was lacking. That owed a great deal to the organisation of the Arsenal defence. Ahead of the last international break, Brighton set a blueprint for getting the better of Arsenal in winning 3-0. Liverpool’s squad profile might have made a similar strategy possible though Iraola’s outfit is struggling to create chances in the same volume as Brighton or his Bournemouth team. John Brewin
Match report: Liverpool 0-1 Arsenal

No shots on target for Liverpool, leaving them with zero margin for the errors that preceded Kai Havertz’s decisive goal. Nine points behind Arsenal with a quarter of the season gone, Liverpool’s season risks becoming a developmental one, a time to regroup and rethink rather than challenging for the title. The squad Iraola inherited still bears the weight of the failed rebuild of the summer of 2025. Florian Wirtz was both unlucky when rattling the crossbar and too ponderous when a second-half chance dropped his way. Alexander Isak is nothing like the busy-bee striker his manager asks to press from the front. Milos Kerkez continues to be chaotic. Bradley Barcola, 2026’s headline signing, played his part in the flurry that followed Arsenal’s goal but faded, as did his fellow forwards. There are shards of light. Jérémy Jacquet and Trey Nyoni (aggressive – perhaps too aggressive – and involved in his hour on the field) are young players who can go places. Though it may take some time for Liverpool to get there as a team. JB
Reaction: Iraola responds to Isak penalty denial

The small matter of a glamorous trip to Barcelona comes first for Aston Villa but it is a quirk of timing that Unai Emery’s next Premier League assignment should come at Old Trafford. It is the historical stature of Manchester United that triggered all the controversy over Jamie Carragher’s claim that Emery should be looking to climb the football chain and consider succeeding Michael Carrick should he be sacked. But even if Emery perceived United as a step up (as Youri Tielemans did when trading clubs in the summer, and look where that’s led him), would he prosper there? At Villa Park, he has an increasingly strong hold on how all team affairs are run, as signalled by his nominal upgrade from head coach to manager when he last signed a new contract, and he will visit the Camp Nou looking to extend Villa’s 100% start to their Champions League campaign. Having suffered dips at Paris Saint-Germain and Arsenal, there is no certainty Emery’s methods would work in the febrile cauldron that is Old Trafford. After all, Manchester United will never be Aston Villa. Peter Lansley
Match report: Aston Villa 1-1 Fulham

Bournemouth are in full flow, winning each of their past six matches, scoring 16 goals. All while Alex Scott is absent with the muscle injury sustained with England. Those goals have come unanswered. Marco Rose has added a defensive solidity not always present during Iraola’s era. Last season’s goal difference was +4. Djordje Petrovic has not conceded a goal since the 5-1 defeat at Chelsea on 10 October. “The Chelsea game was the moment we changed all momentum,” said Petrovic after beating Leeds. Rose has admitted testing opening weeks in the Premier League had altered perceptions to force a rethink. “Everyone in the team, starting from the attackers, is doing their job offensively and defensively,” Petrovic said. Since Stamford Bridge, commitment to the collective has paid impressive dividends. “If you have that intensity with the attackers, it gets easier, we have a good group of players with quality and huge rotations in each position.” JB
Match report: Bournemouth 2-0 Leeds United

Roméo Lavia completed his first 90 minutes as a Chelsea player during their Carabao Cup defeat by Liverpool last Wednesday. It was a major milestone for a player who has struggled to stay fit since joining from Southampton three years ago. Lavia’s injury record invites caution but the midfielder is making progress. He followed up his performance against Liverpool with his second consecutive 90-minute display when Chelsea beat Manchester United 2-0 on Saturday. “As long as I feel good, I’ll do everything possible to help the team to get this type of result and I’m feeling good, so I’m very happy with my performance,” Lavia said after starring against United and creating the opening goal for Morgan Rogers. “All I can say is that the work that we’re doing with all the people at the club is going well. It’s just about keeping it going. Hopefully it can continue this way.” Jacob Steinberg
Match report: Chelsea 2-0 Manchester United

With Tottenham cruising towards a third successive Premier League victory, against 10-man Crystal Palace, Roberto De Zerbi decided the time had come in the 88th minute. Luca Williams-Barnett is rated as one of the best prospects to emerge from the Spurs academy in many years but the attacking midfielder has had to be patient for his first league appearance as De Zerbi’s side struggled at the start of the season. The 18-year-old made an instant impression with a sensational first touch and pass after replacing Mathys Tel before setting up Mohammed Kudus for a great chance, to make it 3-0, that was spurned. We can expect to see more of him if De Zerbi gets his way. “My career is clear: when I have young, talented players, nothing changes,” he said. “I thought it was the right moment for him in the Premier League – but as a quality, he’s a big, big talent.” Ed Aarons

Match report: Tottenham 2-0 Crystal Palace

After Fabian Hürzeler masterminded Brighton’s fine 1-0 win at Manchester City that lifted the Seagulls to 19 points, only two behind their hosts, the manager pointed to the culture he is building. “For me, I think it’s a lot about connection. We work in the people business. And we speak a lot about players. But for me, it’s more important to understand the person behind the player. And therefore, we try to build a lot on connection. We try to build a lot on culture. Because I think having the right values, having the right connection, the right relationship between the players helps you massively on the pitch. On the pitch, they need to rely on each other, trust each other. And you can only build this on and off the pitch. And therefore, we try to emphasise this a lot.” Jamie Jackson
Match report: Manchester City 0-1 Brighton

The oddity about Brentford this season is that they’re playing well, have a very good chance of qualifying for Europe for the first time in their history, and yet there’s been a feeling that they’ve been leaving points behind. Inexplicably, victory over Nottingham Forest was their first win in five and their first clean sheet since the 3-0 demolition of Chelsea six weeks ago. Perhaps the biggest issue in terms of improving on last season’s ninth-placed finish was whether Igor Thiago could match his tally of 22 goals. He’s started this campaign slowly, but got his second of the season with Brentford’s second against Forest. The finish, which looped in off Nikola Milenkovic, was fortuitous and not entirely convincing, but more significant perhaps was the way he stepped back away from the defenders, creating space for Jaidon Anthony to pick him out. That instinct will always generate chances, and the finishing will surely return. Jonathan Wilson
Match report: Brentford 2-0 Nottingham Forest

The word at Ipswich is that Julio Enciso has come back to the club with an increased level of maturity after a year in Ligue 1. He occasionally sparkled at Portman Road on loan from Brighton in the second half of the doomed 2024-25 season but lacked consistency. This season he already has two goals, a pair of assists and has become Ipswich’s chief creator. Enciso is comfortably top of the club’s chances-created chart, the Paraguayan’s tally of 14 is nearly double the next names on the list – Sasa Lukic, Emersonn and Abdul Fatawu, who have eight apiece. After the Tractor Boys had managed to turn a 1-0 lead into a 2-1 deficit at Hull, Enciso’s thwack from the edge of the box earned his side a vital point. He will be required to keep producing these kinds of moments if Gary O’Neil’s side are to do what they couldn’t last time around and stay in the top flight for consecutive seasons. Tom Bassam
Match report: Hull City 2-2 Ipswich Town

Régis Le Bris, Sunderland’s head coach, said post-match: “First year in Europe, you will have on average 10 less points. It’s our reality.” The reality is Sunderland have 12 points fewer than they did after nine games last season and if you extrapolate their current form over 38 games it amounts to relegation. Only Crystal Palace have conceded more goals and only Nottingham Forest have scored fewer. It would stun no one to learn that those three clubs make up the bottom three, but what is a surprise is that three promoted sides are all looking capable of avoiding the drop. A word for Coventry, who have responded to a chastening start to the season by winning three of their past five. Beating the teams around you is important in the fight for survival and this was a big tick in that box. TB
Match report: Coventry 3-1 Sunderland

bodyZh: 出色的防守是冠军的标志。在过去13次造访安菲尔德均未取胜的客场，米克尔·阿尔特塔在球队取得领先后采取了稳健防守的常规战术。这一次，事实证明取得了成功。阿森纳没有像以往那样让比赛气氛或球场氛围压倒自己。2023年4月，扎卡与亚历山大-阿诺德的纠缠激起了主场球迷的斗志，当时阿森纳曾2-0领先，最终战平2-2。周日，利物浦在安东尼·伊劳拉的要求下积极拼抢，但最后一传的质量有所欠缺，这很大程度上要归功于阿森纳严密的防守组织。在上一个国际比赛日之前，布莱顿曾以3-0取胜，为如何击败阿森纳树立了样板。利物浦的阵容配置本可能让类似的战术成为可能，但伊劳拉的球队在创造机会的数量上一直无法与布莱顿或他执教的伯恩茅斯相比。约翰·布鲁文
比赛报告：利物浦 0-1 阿森纳

利物浦全场没有一次射正，这让他们在哈弗茨攻入制胜球之前的失误没有留下任何容错空间。在赛季进行四分之一之际，利物浦落后阿森纳九分，这支球队的赛季有沦为一个重建与反思阶段的风险，而非争夺冠军。伊劳拉接手的阵容依然背负着2025年夏天失败重建的包袱。弗洛里安·维尔茨击中横梁时运气不佳，而在下半场获得机会时又显得有些犹豫。亚历山大·伊萨克一点也不像他的主帅所要求的那样在前场积极逼抢的射手。米洛斯·克尔凯兹表现依然有些混乱。作为2026年的重磅引援，布拉德利·巴尔科拉在阿森纳进球后的反扑中发挥了一定作用，但随后和队友们一起沉寂了。不过也有闪光点。热雷米·雅凯和特雷·尼奥尼（表现得很有侵略性，或许有些过头，在场上的一个小时里表现活跃）是未来可期的年轻球员。尽管利物浦作为一支球队达到理想状态可能还需要一些时间。JB
赛后反应：伊劳拉回应伊萨克点球争议

对于阿斯顿维拉来说，首先要面对的是一场前往巴塞罗那的引人注目的欧冠客场比赛，但赛程巧合的是，埃梅里的下一场英超任务将是在老特拉福德球场进行。正是曼联的历史地位引发了有关杰米·卡拉格言论的所有争议，卡拉格称埃梅里应该寻求提升自己的执教生涯，并在迈克尔·卡里克被解雇时考虑接替其职位。但即使埃梅里认为曼联是一个上升的台阶（正如尤里·蒂勒曼斯在夏天转会时所想的那样，看看他现在的结果），他在那里会成功吗？在维拉公园球场，他对俱乐部所有事务的掌控力越来越强，这一点在他上次签下新合同从主教练（head coach）名义上升级为经理（manager）时就得到了体现，他将带着维拉在欧冠中100%的全胜战绩前往诺坎普。由于曾在巴黎圣日耳曼和阿森纳遭遇过低谷，埃梅里的一套方法能否在老特拉福德这个充满狂热的熔炉中奏效并没有绝对的把握。毕竟，曼联永远不会是阿斯顿维拉。彼得·兰斯利
比赛报告：阿斯顿维拉 1-1 富勒姆

伯恩茅斯状态正佳，近期各项赛事取得六连胜，共打入16球，且期间一球未失。这一切都是在亚历克斯·斯科特因在英格兰队效力时遭遇肌肉受伤而缺阵的情况下取得的。马尔科·罗斯为球队增添了伊劳拉执教时期并不总是具备的防守稳固性。上赛季球队的净胜球为+4。自10月10日1-5惨败给切尔西以来，乔尔杰·彼得罗维奇就没有再失过球。“对阵切尔西的比赛是我们改变所有势头的转折点，”彼得罗维奇在击败利兹联后说道。罗斯承认，英超开局阶段的严峻考验改变了人们的看法，并促使球队进行了反思。“球队中的每个人，从前锋开始，都在进攻和防守端做好自己的工作，”彼得罗维奇说。自斯坦福桥之战以来，全队的奉献精神带来了令人瞩目的回报。“如果你对前锋有这种强度要求，事情就会变得更容易，我们拥有一个实力雄厚、各位置轮换出色的优秀球员群体。”JB
比赛报告：伯恩茅斯 2-0 利兹联

罗密欧·拉维亚在上周三联赛杯输给利物浦的比赛中首次代表切尔西踢满全场。对于三年前从南安普顿加盟以来一直难以保持健康的球员来说，这是一个重大的里程碑。拉维亚的伤病记录让人不得不谨慎对待，但这位中场球员正在取得进步。在对阵利物浦的比赛之后，他在周六切尔西2-0击败曼联的比赛中再次打满全场，完成了连续两场踢满90分钟的比赛。“只要我感觉良好，我就会尽一切可能帮助球队取得这样的结果，而且我现在感觉很好，所以我对自己的表现非常满意，”拉维亚在对阵曼联表现出色并为摩根·罗杰斯创造首开纪录的机会后说道。“我能说的是，我们在俱乐部与所有人一起进行的工作进展顺利。关键在于保持这种势头。希望它能继续这样下去。”雅各布·斯坦伯格
比赛报告：切尔西 2-0 曼联

随着托特纳姆热刺在对阵10人作战的水晶宫时朝着英超三连胜稳步迈进，罗伯托·德泽尔比在第88分钟认为时机已到。卢卡·威廉姆斯-巴内特被认为是热刺青训多年来涌现出的最佳新星之一，但由于热刺在赛季初战绩挣扎，这位攻击型中场不得不耐心地等待他的首场英超亮相。这位18岁的球员在替补登场换下马修·特尔后，凭借惊艳的第一次触球和传球立即留下了深刻印象，随后为穆罕默德·库杜斯创造了一个绝佳机会，可惜对方将比分扩大为3-0的机会错失了。如果德泽尔比如愿以偿，我们可以期待看到他更多地出场。“我的执教生涯很明确：当我拥有年轻、有天赋的球员时，一切都不会改变，”他说。“我认为这是他在英超联赛中登场的正确时机——就其实力而言，他是一个非常、非常杰出的天才。”埃德·阿隆斯

在法比安·许尔泽勒率领布莱顿在客场1-0击败曼城、将积分提升至19分（仅落后主队两分）之后，这位主帅谈到了他正在打造的球队文化。“对我来说，我认为这很大程度上关乎人与人之间的联系。我们从事的是人的行业。我们经常谈论球员。但对我来说，更重要的是去理解球员背后的那个人。因此，我们试图在联系上做很多工作。我们试图在文化上做很多工作。因为我认为拥有正确的价值观、正确的联系、球员之间正确的关系会在球场上对你产生巨大的帮助。在球场上，他们需要彼此依靠、彼此信任。你只能在场上和场下建立这种关系。因此，我们试图对此进行很多强调。”杰米·杰克逊
比赛报告：曼城 0-1 布莱顿

本赛季布伦特福德的神奇之处在于他们踢得很好，有很大机会历史上首次获得欧战资格，然而人们总有一种他们一直在丢分的印象。令人费解的是，战胜诺丁汉森林是他们五场比赛以来的首场胜利，也是他们自六周前3-0大胜切尔西以来的首场零封。就提升上赛季第九名的成绩而言，最大的问题或许是伊戈尔·蒂亚戈能否追平他22个进球的纪录。他本赛季开局慢热，但在对阵森林队的比赛中打入了本赛季的第二个进球。这个进球是通过折射尼科拉·米伦科维奇的防守吊入网窝的，带有一定的幸运成分且并不完全令人信服，但更有意义的或许是他从后卫身旁撤开的方式，为杰登·安东尼送出传球创造了空间。这种本能总是能创造机会，进球效率也势必会恢复。乔纳森·威尔逊
比赛报告：布伦特福德 2-0 诺丁汉森林

伊普斯维奇的消息称，儒利奥·恩西索在法甲度过了一年之后，带着更加成熟的心态回到了俱乐部。在2024-25赛季降级阴云笼罩的下半赛季，他以租借身份从布莱顿加盟波特曼路球场时偶尔能闪光，但缺乏稳定性。本赛季他已经打入两球并送出两次助攻，成为了伊普斯维奇的主要创造者。恩西索在俱乐部创造机会榜上高居榜首，这位巴拉圭球员的14次关键传球几乎是榜单上第二名萨沙·卢基奇、埃默森和阿卜杜勒·法塔wu（每人8次）的两倍。在“拖拉机男孩”将1-0的领先优势挥霍成1-1的平局甚至2-1落后于赫尔城之后，恩西索在禁区边缘的抽射为球队赢得了一个至关重要的一分。如果加里·奥尼尔的球队想要做到上赛季未能做到事——在顶级联赛中连续第二个赛季保级，他们将需要恩西索继续贡献这样的精彩表现。汤姆·巴萨姆
比赛报告：赫尔城 2-2 伊普斯维奇镇

桑德兰主帅雷吉斯·勒布里在赛后表示：“第一次踢英超，平均会少拿10分。这就是我们的现实。”现实是，桑德兰本赛季前九场比赛过后比上赛季少拿了12分，如果按38场比赛来推算他们目前的状态，那就相当于降级。只有水晶宫失球更多，只有诺丁汉森林进球更少。如果得知这三家俱乐部占据了积分榜倒数三位，任何人也不会感到震惊，但令人惊讶的是三支升班马看起来都有能力避免降级。不得不提一下考文垂，他们在经历了开局的沉重打击后，在最近五场比赛中赢了三场。在保级战中击败身边的直接对手至关重要，这场胜利在这一项上打了一个大大的勾。TB

bodyEn: Andoni Iraola said he will instruct Liverpool players to go down in the box in future after Alexander Isak was denied a penalty during Arsenal’s first win at Anfield for 14 years.

Liverpool were beaten by Kai Havertz’s early strike after a poor clearance from the goalkeeper ­Alisson but had two penalty claims dismissed by the referee, Andy Madley. The first, a shirt-pull by the Arsenal defender Jurriën Timber on Isak, prevented the ­Sweden international reaching Bradley Barcola’s cross. The second, a hold by Christos ­Tzolis on Cody Gakpo, was reviewed by the video assistant referee, Stuart Attwell, but rejected.

Isak stood his ground when held by Timber and Iraola claimed that counted against his team. Asked whether Isak should have collapsed in the area, the Liverpool head coach replied: “It’s a shame you ask me this question but, honestly, yes, we have to tell them to go down because they’re not going to call it otherwise.

“And then referees complain why they go down. Because if you don’t go down, you don’t call it. I think Alex is honest. He tries to go for the ball, everyone can see live straight away there is a clear, clear pull.”

Iraola accepted the reasons for ­dismissing the Gakpo penalty claim but believed they were inconsistent with the explanation for not ­awarding the Isak appeal. “I think there are two situations and they are a bit related,” he said.

“The Isak one is a clear penalty. He is going to head the ball in front of the goal and they grab him where ­everyone sees the shirt. The ball just goes in front of Alex and I don’t see the reason why [it isn’t given]. ­

“Probably because he doesn’t dive or he doesn’t go to the floor. It shouldn’t be a reason not to concede a penalty. The Gakpo one, I think it’s a sustained holding but I understand their argument and I think they are right when they say the ball was too long in the air and Cody wouldn’t have arrived to the ball.
“But then you’re basically ­accepting that the first one is a ­penalty, no? You cannot use the ­argument in both ways differently.”

Iraola’s post-match mood ­contrasted starkly with his childhood friend Mikel Arteta. The Arsenal ­manager, who claimed not to have seen the Isak incident, was elated by his team’s reaction to their Carabao Cup exit at Fleetwood in midweek and his first win at Anfield in charge of the Gunners.
Arteta said: “It feels better as a manager [to win at Anfield] because it has been such a long time without this feeling. I am extremely proud, especially given the conditions we arrived to the game.

“The defeat against Fleetwood looks like the end of the world but then you have to pick yourself up. That is the beautiful part of this game. Four days later you have to come to Anfield, and play against this manager, this team who are in a good moment, and so I am so proud of what my team has done.”
Arsenal have now won at four grounds where they did not win when securing the title last season – Anfield, Villa Park, the Stadium of Light and the City Ground.

“This is a mission we didn’t complete for 14 years,” Arteta said. “There were reasons for that. Some were ­psychological, some were related to the quality we showed on the pitch, and some were decisions. We knew we had to nail all of them. We knew we would have to navigate periods where we had to suffer.”

When informed that his team had denied Liverpool a shot on target in a Premier League game for the first time in 16 years, Arteta said: “I didn’t know about that stat but that is incredible. It didn’t feel like that at the time, they are a team that shoots a lot so you have to be good at denying them space and blocking shots. To do that against this team is remarkable, I would say.”

items.titleZh: 伊劳拉：我们必须告诉球员在禁区里倒地
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳时隔14年客胜利物浦，伊劳拉抱怨伊萨克未获点球并称以后会要求队员倒地。
bodyZh: 在阿森纳时隔14年首次在安菲尔德取胜的比赛中，亚历山大·伊萨克被拒绝了一次点球判罚，安多尼·伊劳拉表示，他未来将指示利物浦球员在禁区内倒地。
利物浦因门将阿利松解围失误被哈弗茨开场破门击败，但主裁判安迪·马德利拒绝了他们的两次点球诉求。第一次是阿森纳后卫尤里恩·廷贝尔拉扯伊萨克球衣，阻止了这位瑞典国脚接应布拉德利·巴尔科拉的传中。第二次是克里斯托斯·齐奥利斯对科迪·加克波的拉拽，经视频助理裁判斯图尔特·阿特维尔复核后被驳回。
伊萨克在被廷贝尔拉拽时站稳了脚跟，伊劳拉称这对其球队不利。当被问及伊萨克是否应该在禁区内倒地时，这位利物浦主帅回答说：“很遗憾你问我这个问题，但说实话，是的，我们必须告诉他们倒地，因为否则裁判不会判罚。”
“然后裁判又抱怨球员为什么倒地。因为如果你不倒地，他们就不吹。我认为亚历斯很诚实。他试图去争抢皮球，每个人都能在直播中立刻看到有一个非常明显的拉拽。”
伊劳拉接受了驳回加克波点球诉求的理由，但认为这与未判罚伊萨克犯规的解释不一致。“我认为有两种情况，它们有点相关，”他说。
“伊萨克那次是明显的点球。他准备在门前头球攻门，而对方拉扯了他的球衣，所有人都看到了。皮球正好落在亚历斯面前，我看不出为什么不判的原因。”
“可能是因为他没有假摔或者没有倒地。这不应成为不判点球的理由。至于加克波那次，我认为这是一次持续的拉拽，但我理解他们的论点，我也认为他们说皮球在空中飞行时间太长、科迪无法触及皮球的观点是正确的。”
“但那样的话，你基本上就承认了第一次是点球，对吧？你不能用两种不同的方式来使用这个论点。”
伊劳拉赛后的情绪与他的童年好友米克尔·阿尔特塔形成鲜明对比。这位阿森纳主教练声称没有看到伊萨克的事发经过，他对球队从周中联赛杯被弗利特伍德淘汰的阴影中恢复过来、以及执教枪手首胜安菲尔德感到欣喜若狂。
阿尔特塔说：“作为一名主教练（在安菲尔德赢球）感觉更好，因为已经有这么长时间没有这种感觉了。我感到极度自豪，特别是考虑到我们来到这里时的状况。”

“输给弗利特伍德看起来像是世界末日，但随后你必须振作起来。这就是这项运动美丽的部分。四天后你必须来到安菲尔德，与这位主教练、这支状态正佳的球队比赛，所以我为我的球队所做的一切感到非常骄傲。”
阿森纳现在已经在上赛季夺冠时未能取胜的四个球场赢球——安菲尔德、维拉公园球场、光明球场和城市球场。
“这是我们14年来未完成的任务，”阿尔特塔说。“这其中有原因。有些是心理上的，有些与我们在球场上展现出的质量有关，还有一些是判罚决定。我们知道我们必须把所有这些都做好。我们知道我们必须度过必须经受煎熬的时期。”
当得知他的球队16年来首次在英超比赛中零封利物浦的射正次数时，阿尔特塔说：“我之前不知道这个数据，但这太不可思议了。当时感觉并非如此，他们是一支射门很多的球队，所以你必须擅长限制他们的空间并封堵射门。对这支球队做到这一点是非常了不起的，我想这么说。”
